test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Move the goalposts

options.text: Unfairly alter the conditions or rules of a procedure during its course
To do your research and understand clearly what your goals are
To put a lot of effort into something
To move the goalpost after an attempt has been made to score a goal

solution:
The correct answer is **'unfairly alter the conditions or rules of a procedure during its course'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'Move the goalposts'** means to change the rules or requirements in a a way that makes success more difficult.

 
 
• Example- We'd almost signed the contract when the other guys moved the goalposts</s
